hazards.location_in_image: Along the curb line on the far side of the street

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Infrastructure
hazards.description: Large support pillars for the elevated transit station block sight lines between drivers and pedestrians at the crossing.
hazards.location_in_image: Center and right side of the roadway under the bridge structure

hazards.name: Poor Lighting/Shadowing
hazards.description: The elevated structure creates deep shadows that can obscure pedestrians from motorists even during daylight.
hazards.location_in_image: Roadway area directly beneath the station structure

hazards.name: Lack of Street Lighting
hazards.description: No street-level lighting is visible, which may create safety issues for pedestrians during nighttime hours.

hazards.name: Multi-lane one-way traffic
hazards.description: The three-lane one-way configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates a significant barrier for pedestrians wishing to cross.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians on the sidewalk and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Buffer
hazards.description: The sidewalk is directly adjacent to the parking and travel lanes with no physical buffer like planters or bollards to protect pedestrians.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the entire visible sidewalk edge

hazards.name: Parked vehicle visual obstruction
hazards.description: On-street parallel parking can obscure pedestrians, particularly children, from the view of oncoming motorists if they attempt to cross mid-block.

hazards.name: Lack of mid-block crossing
hazards.description: Despite the presence of a park on one side and residential housing on the other, there are no marked crossings, forcing pedestrians to cross a wide, uncontrolled roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Entire visible stretch of the roadway

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Continuous parallel parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between drivers and pedestrians who might attempt to cross.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbsides throughout the frame

hazards.name: Lack of Protected Crossing
hazards.description: No marked crosswalks or pedestrian refuge areas are visible in this residential stretch, forcing pedestrians to cross unprotected.

hazards.name: Visual Obstructions from Parking
hazards.description: Parked cars along the right curb can block the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Foliage
hazards.description: Dense, low-hanging tree branches obscure sightlines between the pedestrian walkway and the roadway.
hazards.location_in_image: Upper center and left, overhanging the parked white vehicle

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars block the view of the roadway for pedestrians and the view of pedestrians for drivers.

hazards.name: Lack of marked crossings
hazards.description: No marked pedestrian crossings are visible, forcing pedestrians to cross mid-block without designated protection or right-of-way.

hazards.name: Missing Sidewalk
hazards.description: There is no visible paved sidewalk on the right side of the street, forcing pedestrians to walk in the roadway or on unpaved surfaces.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parking
hazards.description: Continuous on-street parking on both sides of the street obscures sightlines between pedestrians and drivers.

hazards.name: Absence of curbing
hazards.description: The lack of a raised curb allows vehicles to easily encroach upon the pedestrian buffer zone.

hazards.name: Lack of Controlled Crossings
hazards.description: No marked or controlled crossing points are visible in this stretch of road, which borders a park where pedestrian activity is expected.

hazards.name: High Traffic Volume and Multiple Lanes
hazards.description: The presence of at least three travel lanes with heavy vehicle flow increases the risk and difficulty for pedestrians crossing mid-block without assistance.

hazards.name: Narrow Walkway
hazards.description: The sidewalk is narrow, providing limited space for pedestrians to pass one another comfortably.

hazards.name: Degraded Pavement

hazards.name: Lack of Lighting
hazards.description: No street lighting is visible, which may create safety concerns for pedestrians after dark.

hazards.name: Lack of crossing infrastructure
hazards.description: There are no marked crosswalks or signs to facilitate safe pedestrian crossing between the residential area and the park.

hazards.name: Wide, straight roadway
hazards.description: The straight, unobstructed roadway design may encourage vehicle speeds that are inappropriate for a residential area.

hazards.name: Visual obstructions from parked vehicles
hazards.description: Parked cars along both sides of the street can hide pedestrians from the view of approaching drivers, especially at mid-block locations.
hazards.location_in_image: Along both curbs where cars are parked

hazards.name: Wide roadway width
hazards.description: The width of the road and lack of traffic calming measures may encourage higher vehicle speeds in a residential area.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface

hazards.name: Sightline obstructions
hazards.description: Parked vehicles on the left shoulder may obscure pedestrians from the view of oncoming drivers.

hazards.name: Wide Roadway
hazards.description: The four-lane configuration encourages higher vehicle speeds and creates a long, unprotected crossing distance for pedestrians.

hazards.name: Lack of Pedestrian Crossings
hazards.description: There are no visible marked crosswalks or signals to facilitate safe passage between the residential area and the park.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs at the crossing to reduce crossing distance and improve visibility between pedestrians and drivers.

interventions.title: Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a raised island in the center of the roadway to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to ensure clear sight lines.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk
interventions.description: Mark a mid-block crossing with high-visibility paint and appropriate signage to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Under-Bridge Lighting
interventions.description: Add high-intensity LED lighting to the underside of the station structure to eliminate dark spots.

interventions.title: Leading Pedestrian Interval
interventions.description: Program the traffic signals to give pedestrians a head start before vehicle traffic receives a green light.

interventions.title: Pedestrian-Scale Lighting
interventions.description: Install street lamps to improve visibility and security for pedestrians at night.

interventions.title: Raised Crosswalk
interventions.description: Elevate the existing crosswalk to the level of the sidewalk to slow vehicle speeds and increase pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Crossing
interventions.description: Implement a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to break up the long stretch of roadway without crossing opportunities.

interventions.title: Lane Narrowing or Road Diet
interventions.description: Repurpose one travel lane for a protected bike lane or wider buffers to reduce vehicle speeds and the overall crossing distance.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalks
interventions.description: Implement high-visibility continental or ladder-style crosswalk markings to clearly define pedestrian right-of-way.

interventions.title: Street Furniture and Planters
interventions.description: Add street furniture, planters, or additional street trees to create a physical and psychological buffer between the walkway and the roadway.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Install curb extensions at potential crossing points to shorten the crossing distance and bring pedestrians into the driver's line of sight beyond the parked cars.

interventions.title: Marked Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: Add a high-visibility marked crosswalk with appropriate signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point between the residential area and the park.

interventions.title: Speed Humps
interventions.description: Implement traffic calming measures like speed humps to reduce vehicle speeds on this wide, straight residential street.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crosswalk
interventions.description: If pedestrian volumes warrant, install a marked mid-block crossing with appropriate signage to alert drivers.

interventions.title: Traffic Calming Measures
interventions.description: Implement speed humps or cushions to ensure vehicle speeds remain low in this residential context.

interventions.title: Road Diet
interventions.description: Reduce the number of travel lanes to slow traffic and repurpose space for buffers or bike lanes.

interventions.title: Vegetation Management
interventions.description: Prune low-hanging tree branches to a height of at least 8 feet to restore sightlines and clear the pedestrian path.

interventions.title: Sidewalk widening and curbing
interventions.description: Formalize and widen the walkway on the park side with a raised curb to better separate pedestrians from the roadway and parking area.

interventions.title: New Sidewalk Construction
interventions.description: Install a continuous paved sidewalk on the right side of the street to provide a safe walking path.

interventions.title: Mid-block Crossing with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Add a marked mid-block crossing with a pedestrian refuge island to provide a safe point for crossing the wide roadway.

interventions.title: Install Street Lighting
interventions.description: Add pedestrian-scale lighting to improve visibility and perceived safety at night.

interventions.title: Install Raised Curbs
interventions.description: Construct concrete curbs to physically separate the roadway from the grass buffer and sidewalk.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Mid-block Crossing
interventions.description: Install a marked crosswalk with high-visibility paint and signage to provide a designated and safer crossing point.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Widening and Repair
interventions.description: Reconstruct the sidewalk to provide a wider, smoother walking surface that meets accessibility standards.

interventions.title: Vegetated Buffer
interventions.description: Introduce a small planting strip between the curb and the sidewalk to provide separation from parked and moving vehicles.

interventions.title: Marked Crosswalks
interventions.description: Add high-visibility crosswalk markings to designate safe crossing points between the park and residential buildings.

interventions.title: Street Trees and Landscaping
interventions.description: Add street trees along the sidewalk to provide a physical and psychological buffer between pedestrians and moving traffic.

interventions.title: Speed Cushions
interventions.description: Implement speed cushions or humps to physically slow down traffic in this residential corridor.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Repair and Maintenance
interventions.description: Resurface the existing sidewalk to provide a smooth, continuous, and ADA-compliant walking surface.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Completion
interventions.description: Construct a continuous paved sidewalk on the left side of the street to provide a safe, dedicated space for pedestrians.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalks
interventions.description: Install high-visibility marked crosswalks with pedestrian-activated warning lights to facilitate safe crossing.

interventions.title: Mid-block Pedestrian Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a raised median island to allow pedestrians to cross one direction of traffic at a time.

interventions.title: Midblock Crosswalk with Refuge Island
interventions.description: Install a high-visibility marked crosswalk with a central refuge island to break up the crossing distance and provide a safe waiting area.

interventions.title: Street Lighting Installation
interventions.description: Install pedestrian-scale street lighting to improve visibility and safety during evening and night hours.
